narr: The combination of abundant tropical moisture and a weak upper level disturbance produced a complex of slow moving thunderstorms across the Concho Valley. As a result, very heavy rain fell in a short period of time on the morning of August 17 and produced flash flooding in San Angelo and Mertzon. Also, radar rainfall estimates were 9 to 10 inches in northwest Tom Green County, just west of OC Fisher Reservoir.
ev: A National Weather Service Employee reported that South Jackson is blocked off due to flooding. In addition, a video from Facebook showed a high water rescue at the same location.
The San Angelo Police Department reported several streets flooded across San Angelo along with several stranded vehicles.
The Tom Green Sheriffs Office reported flooded roads in Arden.
The Tom Green Sheriffs Office reported widespread flooding along Farm to Market Road 2288.
A social media post indicated several streets and low water crossings flooded in Mertzon.
